name: unbrowse
description: Use websites through the Unbrowse node on this machine: say what you want and get the site's own JSON back, with no browser once a route is learned.

interface.shortDescription: Websites as API calls, through the Unbrowse node on this machine
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the Unbrowse node on this machine. Say what you want from a website and get the site's own JSON back: the node calls the route that does it, or learns one from the page and calls that. When a page needs clicks or typing, Codex drives the node's browser and the node learns a route from those steps.
defaultPrompt: Search Hacker News stories about rust with Unbrowse
